one_line_effect: 'Coerced debt' covers household-purpose debts incurred under coercion in intimate/family relationships; 'creditor' includes the person owed and collectors.

one_line_effect: Chapter 13: creditor may not collect a consumer debt from a co-debtor (co-tenant, guarantor) without stay relief unless the co-debtor became liable in the ordinary course of business.
verbatim_quote: (a) Except as provided in subsections (b) and (c) of this section, after the order for relief under this chapter, a creditor may not act, or commence or continue any civil action, to collect all or any part of a consumer debt of the debtor from any individual that is liable on such debt with the debtor, or that secured such debt, unless- (1) such individual became liable on or secured such debt in the ordinary course of such individual's business; or (2) the case is closed, dismissed, or converted to a case under chapter 7 or 11 of this title.

one_line_effect: Chapter 7: an unexpired residential lease not assumed within 60 days is deemed rejected.
